_comment.about: Delivery-policy owner for the Next.js telemetry lane (ADR-005/ADR-006), mirroring telemetry/dart. base_sdk owns the TelemetryClient every SDK may import (base/nextjs/src/services/telemetry.ts, installed at app/services/base/telemetry.ts); this SDK formally owns WHEN/HOW events leave the browser (the seam/config). Since 1.1.0 it also ships the paas-era reports/analytics surfaces (dashboard and report server actions, the admin reports index/overview pages, the manager reports page, and the shared GenericReport component) as flat templates in the one top-level installs list (no app_type persona blocks; role visibility is handled in the page code). The frappe half (core/telemetry) is the backend: api_error_log + log_frontend_error/track_event whitelisted methods.
_comment.app/services/base/platform-gateway.ts: core/base (installed by base_sdk >= 1.3.0, which carries paasCall on the kernel platform gateway)
